items.question: Can we manage multiple client brands?
items.answer: Yes. Separate Brand Kit profiles per client with role-based team access.

items.question: Does this replace our designers?
items.answer: No. It absorbs production work so seniors focus on strategy, pitches, and creative direction.

items.question: Pitch spec work?
items.answer: Generate concept boards and sample deliverables in hours — reducing unpaid pitch investment.
